question: What is the meaning of end-of-life management in relation to life cycle information?
description: End-of-life management in relation to life cycle information refers to the process of handling products or objects once they reach the end of their useful life. This includes activities such as sorting, collecting, treating, and potentially recycling these items in a sustainable manner. By incorporating end-of-life data into life cycle information, businesses can assess the environmental and social impact of their products throughout their entire life cycle, from production to disposal.
